cases.prompt: 尽量一次做完这个跨文件修复：检查、实现、测试、文档、Git 收尾都由你连续推进；遇到必须我做的登录或 MFA 才停。
Continue executing the authorized implementation. Reduce handoffs, preserve existing edits, and report only real blockers.
Turn this multi-stage migration into one self-contained work package with user-only blockers and retry rules.
请先一次性检查历史、分支、工作区、权限和外部依赖，然后在授权范围内持续完成剩余工作。
The task includes code changes, deterministic tests, docs, evidence, and a clean handoff. Execute it as one bounded workpack.
不要每一步都问我确认；把可执行事项连续完成，只在外部平台审批时暂停并给出唯一操作。
Organize this into inspect → implement → verify → document → close, with checkpoints and no destructive commands.
A second agent must be able to continue this work from a self-contained handoff. Generate and execute the safe parts now.
Run the whole authorized local release-preparation package, but do not publish or deploy without explicit permission.
When a test fails, diagnose and retry within scope instead of stopping after the first error; distinguish partial from complete.
请只解释这个函数做什么，不要修改文件。
请只审查这份计划并列出风险。
请把这段话翻译成中文。
Give me three names for a study app.
Diagnose the bug but do not implement anything.
Write a one-line shell command to list files.
Translate this paragraph into Chinese.
Summarize the attached meeting notes.
Tell me whether this API name is idiomatic.
Draft a short commit message for this change.
